dt-example.title: API methods
dt-example.info:
StateRestore provides a comprehensive API that is fully integrated with [DataTables own API](https://datatables.net/manual/core/api). With the API you can add new states, modify existing ones and of course delete states. Put it all together and you can create a complete UI for StateRestore using your own HTML elements or components.
In this example, the API is used together with the `-event stateRestore` event to provide a very basic interface. You can create new states, delete all, and load, edit, replace or remove individual states.
I wouldn't suggest you use this specific UI for your end users! Rather this is a demonstration to show how the API can be used to create a custom UI.
The `-button stateCreate` and `-button statesList` buttons have been included as well to show the interaction between the two UIs - they stay in sync with either being usable.
